OCR request returning multiple pages of document content

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_ocr_async(client, "{\"document\":{\"type\":\"document_url\",\"url\":\"https://example.com/multipage.pdf\"},\"model\":\"mistral/mistral-ocr-latest\"}")
IO.inspect(result.pages)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.pages, 0).index)
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.pages, 1).index)
```
